_comment: sim/cmrr-psrr PSRR as ONE `klt sim` measurement (issue #307): psrr_db = Av0 - Avs0 in dB, graded against the ratified bound by the tool itself.

Circuit: tb_psrr_direct.body.spice -- two independent copies of the DUT in one deck. Copy A (Vinp ac 1, Vdd quiet) gives Av0; copy B (series source Vsrip ac 1 on its rail, input AC-quiet) gives Avs. They share only quiet reference nodes, so one AC solve is exactly the two single-excitation solves psrr.request.json and the open-loop request run separately.

Grid: cornerMOSlv.lib mos_tt/ss/ff/sf/fs [DR-1] x {-40, 27, 125} C x VDD {1.08, 1.20, 1.32} V = 45 corners, identical to psrr.request.json. vinp sweeps WITH vdd by index (Vcm = VDD/2); copy B's input is a VDD/2 divider off the quiet vdd node.
Each process corner is a bundle carrying the fixed cornerCAP.lib cap_typ section (the Miller cap is a cap_cmim MIM device), as in psrr.request.json.
Analysis: ac dec 20 10m 1g. The DC shelf is the first AC point (10 mHz), below the ~1.5 Hz supply zero, as in the harness.
Ratified row: PSRR+ (DC shelf) >= 1.87 dB worst-case [DR-2] (spec/target-spec.md section 2). It is the `limits.min` of psrr_db, a derived expr measurement: (vdb(outa) - vdb(outb))[0].
av0_db and avs0_db are the two operands read separately, ungraded, so compare_direct.py can check each against the committed single-excitation envelopes.
psrr_plateau_delta_db is the direct form of the join's flat-shelf guard: |PSRR(0.1 Hz) - PSRR(10 mHz)| <= 0.05 dB (dec-20 grid: index 20 is 0.1 Hz). A miss is a result, not hidden.
Solver tolerance: ngspice default, no .options reltol/abstol/vntol (DR-0005).
ngspice_init raises the printed digits only (measureprec for .meas, numdgt for expr); it changes no solver setting.
keep_artifacts is false so the committed envelope carries no host-absolute artifact paths.
remote.hosts 5: the 45-unit job's serial bound exceeds the fleet's whole-job ceiling, so klt shards it into five jobs (one per process corner).
